map.根据凹陷深度、恢复时间和水肿范围进行分级评估: Grading assessment based on pitting depth, recovery time and extent of edema
map.水肿分级（按凹陷深度）：1+ 不超过2mm 轻度、2+ 2–4mm 中度、3+: Edema grading (by pitting depth): 1+ up to 2 mm mild, 2+ 2–4 mm moderate, 3+ 4–6 mm severe, 4+ 6 mm or more very severe; the cause is assessed together with the site and whether it is symmetrical.
map.极深凹陷，皮肤紧绷发亮: Very deep pitting, skin tight and shiny
map.机制：肾小球滤过率下降，水钠潴留: Mechanism: decreased glomerular filtration rate, water and sodium retention
map.起始部位：眼睑、面部（晨起明显）: Starting site: eyelids and face (obvious in the morning)
map.常伴：血尿、蛋白尿、高血压: Often accompanied by: hematuria, proteinuria, hypertension
map.常见疾病：急性肾小球肾炎、急进性肾炎: Common diseases: acute glomerulonephritis, rapidly progressive nephritis
map.机制：大量蛋白尿→低白蛋白血症→血浆胶体渗透压↓: Mechanism: massive proteinuria → hypoalbuminemia → decreased plasma colloid osmotic pressure
map.起始部位：下肢（晨轻暮重），可发展至全身: Starting site: lower limbs (milder in the morning, worse in the evening), may progress to the whole body
map.常伴：大量蛋白尿(≥3.5g/d)、低白蛋白血症、高脂血症: Often accompanied by: massive proteinuria (≥3.5 g/d), hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia
map.常见疾病：肾病综合征（微小病变、膜性肾病等）: Common diseases: nephrotic syndrome (minimal change disease, membranous nephropathy, etc.)
map.心源性：下肢水肿，伴颈静脉怒张、肝大、心衰体征: Cardiogenic: leg edema with jugular venous distension, hepatomegaly and heart failure signs
map.肝源性：腹水为主，伴肝功能异常、低白蛋白: Hepatic: mainly ascites, with abnormal liver function and low albumin
map.单侧水肿：需排查深静脉血栓、淋巴回流障碍: Unilateral edema: deep vein thrombosis and lymphatic drainage disorders must be excluded
map.提示：凹陷性水肿检查常用胫骨前或内踝上方按压5秒。检查时记录凹陷深度、恢复时间和: Note: pitting edema is usually examined by pressing over the pretibial area or above the medial malleolus for 5 seconds. Record the pitting depth, recovery time and extent. Renal edema should be assessed together with urinalysis, renal function and plasma albumin. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.压陷 2mm、1 分钟恢复→1 度（轻度）水肿。: Pitting 2 mm, recovery in 1 minute → grade 1 (mild) edema.
map.凹陷>4mm、恢复>2 分钟→2–3 度，提示低蛋白或心肾源性。: Pitting >4 mm, recovery >2 minutes → grade 2–3, suggesting hypoalbuminemia or a cardiogenic/renal cause.
map.按凹陷深度 mm 与恢复秒数分 1–3 度(或 1–4 度)。: Grades 1–3 (or 1–4) by pitting depth in mm and recovery time in seconds.
map.单侧警惕静脉/淋巴回流障碍，非全身性疾病。: Unilateral edema warns of venous or lymphatic drainage obstruction rather than systemic disease.
map.水肿(凹陷性)分级器，根据凹陷深度、恢复时间和水肿范围进行分级，评估肾性水肿严重: Edema (pitting) grading tool: grades edema by pitting depth, recovery time and extent, assessing the severity of renal edema and its differential diagnosis. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
